followUps.reason: Understand when and why the order was cancelled (ev_03) despite gateway status being CAPTURED (ev_02).
Check payment attempts leading up to capture to verify if duplicate authorizations or retries occurred.
Inspect individual settlement line items and fee/net breakdown to identify specific payment or refund line discrepancies.
Compare expected net versus actual net settlement totals against ledger entries ev_05 and ev_06 to verify payout variance.

findings.statement: The order is marked as CANCELLED (ev_03) due to hotel closure (ev_13), but the gateway payment remains fully CAPTURED with zero refunded amount (ev_02) and internal payment status remains CAPTURED (ev_01).

Refund exception detected under rule D6_REFUND_MISSING. Ledger entries record settlement clearing debit and merchant payable credit of 5,400,000 minor units (ev_05, ev_06), while settlement line 1 matches expected net fee breakdown (ev_11, ev_12).

findings.statement: The order was cancelled due to hotel renovation, but no refund has been processed at the gateway where refunded amount remains 0.
A missing refund exception was detected despite ledger entries for SETTLEMENT_CLEARING and MERCHANT_PAYABLE existing alongside a matching settlement line for gross minor amount 5400000.

data.narrative: The refund exception was triggered under rule D6_REFUND_MISSING with mismatched system ORDER, indicating that the refund was not initiated in the downstream system.
